title: Magic Whiteboard - Dragons Den Winners - The Original & Best
summary: Neil and Laura Westwood pitch their Magic Whiteboard, reusable static-cling whiteboard sheets, to the investors on the BBC's Dragons' Den and win 100,000 pounds of investment.
why: Mentioned as a UK example of a whiteboard product that took off after a Dragons' Den appearance, in threads about whiteboard products.

quote.text: I remember seeing them on the BBC's Dragon's Den and winning over Deborah Meaden and Theo Paphitis
